SELECT p.*, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(pc.PRC_RATING) FROM VW_ACTIVE_PRODUCTS_COMMENTS pc WHERE pc.PR_ID = p.PR_ID), 0) as avgRating, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VW_ACTIVE_PRODUCTS_COMMENTS pc WHERE pc.PR_ID = p.PR_ID) as reviewCount FROM VW_ACTIVE_PRODUCTS p WHERE 1 = 1
AND PR_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND PR_CATEGORY = #{pr_category}
ORDER BY PR_ID DESC
ORDER BY avgRating DESC, PR_ID DESC
ORDER BY PR_PRICE ASC, PR_ID DESC
ORDER BY PR_PRICE DESC, PR_ID DESC
ORDER BY PR_ID DESC
LIMIT #{rowFirst}, #{rowSizePerPage}
SELECT * FROM VW_ACTIVE_PRODUCTS P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTIONS PO ON P.PR_ID = PO.PR_ID WHERE P.PR_ID = #{pr_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCTS_COMMENTS (US_ID, PR_ID, PR_OPT_ID, PR_OPT_NAME, PRC_DESC, PRC_IMAGE, PRC_RATING, PRC_START_DATE) VALUES (#{us_id}, #{pr_id}, #{pr_opt_id}, #{pr_opt_name}, #{prc_desc}, #{prc_image}, #{prc_rating}, #{prc_start_date})
